name: Open in Full Release
description: Adds an 'Open in Full Release' button to the video detail page. Resolves the video's file via Cove's own MaxPath and opens Full Release in a new tab with that file preselected, ready for Inspect. Only files under Full Release's configured media root are reachable. No job runs inside Cove and nothing is queued; this is a pure hand-off to the operator console. Set the target with the FULL_RELEASE_URL environment variable on the Cove container.
author: Christoph
